canonical_id: LargeMonitor frozen-foundation-model drift monitoring and shift diagnosis

source.paper: LargeMonitor: Monitoring Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Large Pretrained Models

artifact_evidence.official_code: substantial research implementation is public at the pinned commit, including the Disjoint continual-learning code, dataset wrappers, LargeMonitor/LVMonitor monitoring code, ImageNet-HS stream construction, and DINO-feature monitoring scripts
artifact_evidence.same_label_shift_stream: imagenet_hs.py deterministically defines a 10-step ImageNet-HS stream over 50 shared Tiny-ImageNet/ImageNet-R synsets. Within each group A-E, the Tiny-ImageNet source step precedes a step with the same label indices under ImageNet-R domain shift or Tiny-ImageNet corruption; new-class steps appear between groups.
artifact_evidence.monitor_surface: disjoint_dino_cka_hs.py exposes a runnable frozen-DINO feature-buffer CKA monitor, records task/group/source/change_type/batch metadata and CKA values, defaults to batch_size=64 and buffer_size=10000, and supports deterministic task-order shuffling by seed.

environment_release.readme: README.md at the audited commit contains only the project title and no installation or reproduction procedure.
environment_release.dependency_lock: No requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, environment.yml, lockfile, or equivalent dependency manifest was identified in the audited repository tree.
environment_release.release_tags: No GitHub Releases were present in the releases endpoint during this audit.
environment_release.hardware: disjoint_dino_cka_hs.py explicitly raises RuntimeError when CUDA is unavailable.
environment_release.model_path: lvmonitor/disjoint_dino.py defines MODEL_ROOT using an absolute /data/models path and expects a local DINOv3 model directory, so model acquisition/version identity is not self-contained by the repository commit.
environment_release.datasets: ImageNet-HS expects local Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, and corrupted Tiny-ImageNet directory trees; dataset bytes/checksums are not bundled by the repository commit.

artifact_evidence.results_artifacts: No committed paper-result bundle, alarm-event ledger, frozen output table, or dependency-locked end-to-end reproduction recipe was identified in the audited tree. The public code makes the stream and monitor inspectable, but the paper's exact alarm-quality and downstream continual-learning result cells are not reconstructable from a single archived run artifact in this pass.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: strong for inspecting and reimplementing the same-label stream plus frozen-feature monitoring mechanism; moderate-to-weak for exact paper-result replay
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: no clear independent quantitative rerun identified in the targeted public search on 2026-08-25; absence of located search hits is not evidence that none exists
reproducibility_assessment.failed_independent_replication: not identified in the targeted search
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: LargeMonitor has meaningful author-side implementation evidence: the heterogeneous same-label shift stream is explicit in code, and the frozen-DINO monitoring pathway is executable in principle. Reproducibility of the paper's exact detection/diagnosis quality and continual-learning gains is materially weaker because the repository lacks a usable setup README and dependency lock, requires CUDA plus external datasets/model files, contains an absolute model-path dependency, and does not expose a frozen paper-run result bundle or event-level alarm ledger at the audited commit. The mechanism should therefore be treated as publicly implementable but the headline scientific results remain primary-study evidence until a provenance-equivalent rerun is located or executed.
exact_blockers: No dependency/environment lock or complete installation recipe was identified at the audited commit.
The DINO monitor requires CUDA and a separately provisioned local DINOv3 model under an absolute /data/models path; exact model artifact identity is not pinned by the repository.
ImageNet-HS depends on external Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, and corruption data layouts without repository-bundled dataset hashes/manifests sufficient for byte-identical reconstruction.

No committed event-level alarm outputs or paper-result bundle was identified for recomputing false positives, missed shifts, detection delay, diagnosis accuracy, or downstream continual-learning gains without rerunning models.

The targeted public search surfaced the primary paper/repository and mirrors but no clearly independent provenance-equivalent numerical rerun; this is search-window evidence only, not a claim of nonexistence.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Supports reproducibility of the ImageNet-HS stream definition and the existence of a frozen-foundation-model monitoring implementation. It does not independently verify the paper's claim of precise/robust drift detection, shift diagnosis, or downstream continual-learning improvement. Same-label domain-shift stream availability should not be conflated with calibrated alarm quality.

downstream_note: For a low-cost independent reproduction, first freeze dataset hashes and DINO model revision, then run only the ImageNet-HS monitor path on a fixed ordered stream and a seeded shuffled stream. Persist per-batch CKA plus true change_type and compute explicit delay/FPR/miss metrics before testing any adaptive learner response. This separates representation-signal reproducibility from diagnosis and continual-learning policy benefit.
